notes.title: Improved game visuals
notes.notes:
Since the release of the trailer, a little work has been done to improve the visuals
-Developed Lizard Buildings
-Improved Landscape
-The texture of the hut has been reworked and other buildings will also be reworked.
-Added More vegetation
On the last screenshots it was and became

A story campaign of 7 missions and extra-story content are also being developed.
